questionText: Comment on the suitability of the occasion wear shown above. Refer to: shape; comfort; design features.
stem: ‘Fashions fade, style is eternal.’ (Yves Saint Laurent)

rows.verbatim: Suitability of the occasion wear shown

options: fitted bodice gives a slimming effect
short underskirt adds height to the outfit
comfort: flowing fabric is comfortable to wear
short length in the jacket gives height to the man
short sleeves in jacket give length to arms

heldReason: Marks two outfit photographs printed on the paper. Every marking point describes those images ("strong ballerina line", "folded skirt adds width", "single button detail on jacket", "contrasting handkerchief in jacket pocket"), so the card is unanswerable without the figures and the markdown extraction does not carry them.
